hooks.command: H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/current/scripts/hooks/git_ceiling_env.sh; [ -x "$H" ] && "$H" && exit 0; echo "【钩子告警】git_ceiling_env.sh 缺失或出错（$H），本会话没有 GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES 保护，cd 出工作区后别跑 git；请 one-ops 执行 scripts/gates/install.sh"; exit 0

H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/current/scripts/hooks/start_sheet.py; [ -x "$H" ] && "$H" --hook && exit 0; echo "【钩子告警】start_sheet.py 缺失或出错（$H），没有开工单；手动读 docs/modernization/sessions/<会话名>.md 并向调度要卡；请 one-ops 执行 scripts/gates/install.sh"; exit 0

H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/current/scripts/gates/pre_tool_dispatch.py; [ -x "$H" ] || { echo "生产写门入口缺失或不可执行（$H），按拒绝处理；请 one-ops 执行 scripts/gates/install.sh" >&2; exit 2; }; "$H"; c=$?; [ "$c" = 0 ] || [ "$c" = 2 ] && exit "$c"; echo "生产写门异常退出（退出码 $c：崩溃、解释器缺失或被终止），按拒绝处理；请把报错转 one-ops" >&2; exit 2
